decisions.quote:
Thus, H1 was supported only when examining
Meldrum, Lehmann, and Flexon’s (2021) single purge question among
respondents without prior offending history.
decisions.reason: The study tested two preregistered replication hypotheses from Meldrum et al. (2021): while H2 (psychopathic traits and low self-control predicting purging) was supported, H1 (an endorsement rate comparable to the original 18%) was not supported in the full sample (30.4% on the single item and 76.7% on the questionnaire) and held only on the single purge question among the subgroup without prior offending history.
